record.title: FICC membership decision under GSD rules
kv: GSD Rules 2, 2A and 3A allocate admission and continuing requirements.
An applicant seeks GSD membership or a sponsored relationship.
Fixed Income Clearing Corporation (registered or chartered)
FICC acting through its authorized membership decision process
Identify the requested membership class and applicable rule. Obtain the required acceptance and satisfy continuing conditions.
FICC’s decision role does not make its parent, a technology vendor or a sponsor the final membership authority.
Fixed Income Clearing Corporation: SEC lists FICC as a registered clearing agency.
